QuestInfo.name: Battle at the Ocean Bluff: Aiding the Archers
QuestInfo.0:
Eliminate the Ebonstar Foot Soldiers and Ebonstar Archers besieging the Archer's Lookout.

After the Archer's Lookout absorbs enough damage, it will fire a counterattack eliminating all Ebonstar Archers in the surrounding area.
